nodes.label: ESP32 Firmware (PowerGuard field unit)
nodes.rationale: Measures mains voltage and current, watches smoke and rain, derives line faults and publishes to Firebase RTDB; implements the 03-data-model contract.

nodes.label: Rain water detector (switched supply)
nodes.rationale: Plate corrodes under constant DC, so it is powered ~30 ms per second only while sampling.

nodes.label: GPIO / ADC1 pin map (34,35,32,33,27,2)
nodes.rationale: All analog inputs on ADC1 because ADC2 is unusable while Wi-Fi is on.

nodes.label: Analog front-end design (dividers, bias network)
nodes.rationale: ZMPT101B and MQ-135 modules run on 5 V so outputs can exceed the ESP32 3.3 V ADC limit; 10k/20k divider is not optional. SCT-013-015 is the voltage-output type with VCC/2 bias and no burden resistor; the -000 current-output type needs a burden and a different i_gain.

nodes.label: Mains safety warning
nodes.rationale: Only qualified people on 230 V; fuse ZMPT input; clamp CT around a single conductor; isolated supply; monitoring aid not certified protection.

nodes.label: Firmware setup procedure (secrets.h, pio upload, uid whitelist)
nodes.norm_label: firmware setup procedure (secrets.h, pio upload, uid whitelist)

nodes.label: Serial calibration console (cal vzero/izero/v/i/mq)
nodes.rationale: Until cal v is done voltage faults are suppressed; until cal mq is done smoke sensing is OFF and smoke_ppm omitted. Deliberate so placeholder values cannot make a healthy line or clean air look faulty.

nodes.label: Published RTDB paths and cadence (live 2s, status 2s, history 10s)
nodes.rationale: If sensing stalls for 5 s the unit stops writing so the app shows offline instead of trusting an old reading.
nodes.norm_label: published rtdb paths and cadence (live 2s, status 2s, history 10s)

nodes.label: Fault classification and debounce (short, over_current, over_voltage, open_line, under_voltage)
nodes.rationale: Each condition debounced independently; most severe reported; defaults mirror app 180-260 V / 10 A window; over_current delayed 3 s to ride through motor inrush; detector suppressed when front end unplugged/railed.
nodes.norm_label: fault classification and debounce (short, over_current, over_voltage, open_line, under_voltage)

nodes.label: Read-only realtime client architecture
nodes.rationale: Four forces: correct alerts above all (pure module outside React so UI and background cannot disagree); firmware is untrusted input (one non-throwing parser); selector-based stores for 2 s updates on low-end phones; no paid Firebase features so everything client-side and alerts best-effort.

nodes.label: Trust boundaries (ESP32 only writer, app reader, simulator admin)
nodes.norm_label: trust boundaries (esp32 only writer, app reader, simulator admin)

nodes.label: Shared constants (LIVE_INTERVAL_S, OFFLINE_THRESHOLD_S, ALERT_CONFIRM_SAMPLES, ...)
nodes.rationale: Single source in src/domain/constants.ts; code must import rather than repeat numbers.

nodes.label: Layered architecture (UI, State, Runtime core, Domain, Services)
nodes.norm_label: layered architecture (ui, state, runtime core, domain, services)

nodes.label: Layer rules (screens never import services; domain imports no React/native)
nodes.rationale: Runtime core singletons run whether or not any screen is mounted, enabling the foreground service; data flows one way RTDB to UI/effects.
nodes.norm_label: layer rules (screens never import services; domain imports no react/native)

nodes.label: alertEngine (pure reduceAlerts reducer)
nodes.rationale: Most correctness-critical module: pure reducer with no timers, I/O or clock; per-key streak and notified state give glitch suppression, one notification per episode, no re-notify after restart; disabled-then-enabled type notifies on next true sample intentionally.

nodes.label: alertController (store subscriber, persists state, dispatches effects)
nodes.norm_label: alertcontroller (store subscriber, persists state, dispatches effects)

nodes.label: backgroundService (foreground service)
nodes.rationale: Foreground task only keeps JS alive; existing singletons do the work so duplicate alerts are impossible. Uses foreground service type specialUse because dataSync is time-limited on Android 15+.

nodes.label: Chart and history pipeline
nodes.rationale: All history queries use orderByChild('ts') with .indexOn ts so push() keys and ring-buffer slots both work; events from 10 s samples can miss sub-10 s conditions that still alert via /live.

nodes.label: Tech stack with rationale
nodes.rationale: RN CLI bare + Hermes for native control; React Native Firebase for native listeners and offline cache; Zustand for selector re-renders; Notifee for channels/foreground service; Reanimated for UI-thread animation; Maestro + Firebase Emulator for deterministic E2E.
